PraisonAIUI ships a multi-agent task tracking workspace under the Work sidebar group with three built-in views: Page ID Title Description work Work Hub Full-bleed workspace combining the kanban board, card details, chat, and job log kanban Kanban Multi-agent task board with drag-and-drop columns and live SSE sync jobs-board Jobs Board Async jobs (GET /api/jobs/board) grouped by execution status All three pages belong to the built-in plugin builtin.work, backed by KanbanFeature (/api/kanban/*).

Every board organizes cards across seven workflow columns (plus archived, hidden unless ?archived=true): triage → todo → ready → running → blocked → review → done Each task card tracks title, status, assignee, priority, tenant, board, body, comments, meta, and optional child subtask progress (children or meta.progress).

Method Path Description GET /api/kanban/board Get columns and cards (?board=default&tenant=...&archived=false) GET /api/kanban/boards List available board names POST /api/kanban/tasks Create a task (201) POST /api/kanban/tasks/bulk Move multiple task_ids to a target status GET /api/kanban/tasks/{task_id} Fetch full task details PATCH /api/kanban/tasks/{task_id} Update task fields DELETE /api/kanban/tasks/{task_id} Delete a task POST /api/kanban/tasks/{task_id}/move Move a task to a new column ({"status": "review"}) POST /api/kanban/tasks/{task_id}/comments Append a comment ({"text": "...", "author": "..."}) GET /api/kanban/events SSE stream (text/event-stream) of task changes (?board=default&since=0) GET /api/kanban/health Store health, task count, and board list

By default KanbanFeature uses SimpleKanbanStore (in-memory, zero dependencies). Subclass KanbanStoreProtocol from praisonaiui.features.kanban to persist boards in SQL, Redis, or an external issue tracker, and register a factory via praisonaiui.backends.set_kanban_store_factory(...).
